// removes OpenSSL dep when TLS=OFF)
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_STREAM_CLIENT:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenStreamDifferencer: computes velocity, acceleration,
// and jerk of the token weight series for early reversal detection
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_STREAM_DIFFERENCER:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenStreamHealthMonitor: watchdog detecting feed stalls
// and token floods via inter-arrival rate tracking
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_STREAM_HEALTH:BOOL=ON

//Build TemporalPatternLibrary: trie-based multi-token pattern
// matcher with pre-computed sentiment boosts
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TEMPORAL_PATTERN:BOOL=ON

//Enable TLS support via OpenSSL in LLMStreamClient (auto-disabled
// if OpenSSL not found)
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TLS:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenBiasHeatmap: per-token cumulative bias contribution
// tracker with top-N query and capacity cap
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_BIAS_HEATMAP:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenClockRecalibrator: detects drift between token-stream
// timestamps and wall-clock time, compensates token weights
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_CLOCK_RECALIBRATOR:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenCostBudget: real-time LLM API cost limiter with soft/hard
// budget tiers
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_COST_BUDGET:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenImportanceDecayScheduler: exponential token weight
// decay by token age and recency, for temporal relevance weighting
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_DECAY_SCHEDULER:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenInformationBottleneck: per-token IB relevance/complexity
// scoring for online vocabulary pruning
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_IB:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenInfluenceAttributor: Shapley-inspired per-token marginal
// contribution attribution at signal generation time
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_INFLUENCE:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenNgramProfiler: sliding-window n-gram frequency tracker
// for detecting repeated narrative patterns
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_NGRAM_PROFILER:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenPrefixCache: trie-based KV-cache prefix sharing for
// token sequences with LRU eviction
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_PREFIX_CACHE:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenWeightQuantiser: stochastic rounding to a fixed grid
// preserving E[w] exactly for integer-precision downstream
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_QUANTISER:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenStreamRecorder: append-only binary audit log with
// CRC-32 integrity and auto-rotation for regulatory compliance
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_RECORDER:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenReplayRecorder: binary token stream recorder and deterministic
// replay engine
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TOKEN_REPLAY:BOOL=ON

//Build TradingHoursGuard: NYSE/NASDAQ session-aware signal gating
// with DST-aware ET clock
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TRADING_HOURS:BOOL=ON

//Build with ThreadSanitizer (Debug only; mutually exclusive with
// ASAN)
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TSAN:BOOL=OFF

//Build TokenSentimentMomentumIndex: composite ROC+acceleration+SSI
// momentum index in [-1,1]; fires on_momentum_shift on zero-cross
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_TSMI:BOOL=ON

//Build BiasVelocityBreaker: EMA-smoothed rate-of-change circuit
// breaker; trips when |Δbias| EMA > max_velocity threshold
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_VELOCITY_BREAKER:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenVelocityTracker: first and second time-derivatives
// of bias stream for momentum and regime detection
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_VELOCITY_TRACKER:BOOL=ON

//Build VolatilityForecaster: EWMA-based realized-vol forecast
// with regime-adaptive decay
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_VOLATILITY_FORECASTER:BOOL=ON

//Build WalkForwardValidator: rolling walk-forward out-of-sample
// validation with optional ParameterSweep per fold
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_WALK_FORWARD:BOOL=ON

//Build WarmupSequencer: pre-seed pipeline EMA accumulators with
// synthetic tokens before live streaming
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_WARMUP_SEQUENCER:BOOL=ON

//Build TokenWeightHistogram: 20-bucket discretized histogram of
// bias values with entropy and mode tracking
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_WEIGHT_HISTOGRAM:BOOL=ON

//Build SentimentZScoreTracker: rolling Z-score of bias relative
// to expanding or rolling mean/std; fires on_extreme_zscore
LLMQUANT_ENABLE_ZSCORE_TRACKER:BOOL=ON

//Treat all compiler warnings as errors
LLMQUANT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS:BOOL=OFF

//Value Computed by CMake
LLMTokenStreamQuantEngine_BINARY_DIR:STATIC=R:/workspaces/LLMTokenStreamQuantEngine/build-check

//Value Computed by CMake
LLMTokenStreamQuantEngine_IS_TOP_LEVEL:STATIC=ON

//Value Computed by CMake
LLMTokenStreamQuantEngine_SOURCE_DIR:STATIC=R:/workspaces/LLMTokenStreamQuantEngine

//The directory containing a CMake configuration file for spdlog.
spdlog_DIR:PATH=spdlog_DIR-NOTFOUND
